summary: Completed the first scenario-complete Twist Bioscience security review using current SEC primary evidence and the canonical 2026-08-04 MACD crossover. Fiscal Q3 revenue grew 23% to USD 118.4 million, gross margin reached 52.8%, guidance rose to USD 456-457 million, and liquidity remained adequate, but GAAP losses, cash use, stock compensation, dilution, and valuation remain material. The deterministic assessment recorded Sell, Avoid, 74 quality, medium confidence, and USD 38.81/USD 69.69/USD 105.47 bear/base/bull fair values with USD 67.582 probability-weighted value against USD 99.45. Allocation remains ineligible; no strategy, signal, paper order, issue, or follow-up operation was created.

evidence.claim: The fiscal Q3 SEC filing reported nine-month revenue of USD 332.8 million, operating loss of USD 115.0 million, operating cash use of USD 41.3 million, property-and-equipment purchases of USD 27.6 million, stock compensation of USD 50.4 million, and 62,707,424 shares outstanding on July 29, 2026; cash plus short-term investments was approximately USD 166.8 million at June 30.

The SEC-filed fiscal Q3 release reported 23% revenue growth to USD 118.4 million, 52.8% gross margin, a USD 35.1 million net loss, negative USD 11.3 million adjusted EBITDA, approximately 2,650 customers, 369,000 genes shipped, raised fiscal 2026 revenue guidance of USD 456-457 million, and a Q4 adjusted-EBITDA breakeven target.

The canonical alert measured a 9.25% adjusted-close rise from 2026-07-07 through 2026-08-04 to USD 99.45 and a bullish MACD crossover with strength 0.0722; RSI was 60.28, volume was not anomalous, and the close remained just below the upper Bollinger band. The SEC-filed Q3 results plausibly explain the repricing, which this review classified as improved expectations and valuation/timing risk rather than a paper-buy signal.

Deterministic assessment version 2 derived USD 67.582 probability-weighted fair value, -32.0442% expected return, -24.0332% confidence-adjusted expected return, USD 55.752 buy-below price, -42.7034% margin of safety, Sell canonical rating, Avoid portfolio action, Watch conviction tier, 74 quality, and allocation ineligibility with complete threshold-frontier reasons.
